column2: You must hand a coding task off to another agent in its own worktree. You will not supervise it, review it, or wait for it.
You must split a migration across four agents, gate each stage on the previous one passing, and wait for every worker to report done before merging.
You must read what is currently on screen in the Spotify desktop app and click its play button.
You want codex to implement a fix in its own worktree while you review the diff and gate the merge.
You must read the last 50 lines of an Orca terminal and then send it a command.
You must find every caller of a function before renaming it.
